```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
```
# Define peri-cenrtomeric genes based on the histone states
```{r}
chromatin_states <- read.csv2("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/001_chromatin_states/chromatin_states_in_windows.csv")
# Mark peri-centromeric regions
peri_centromeres_chromatin <- chromatin_states[chromatin_states$merged_state=="CH" & chromatin_states$pct > 20 ,]
# Define the same windows in gff file
annotation_athaliana <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/genes.bed",header=FALSE, select = c(1,2,3,4))
setnames(annotation_athaliana, c("chr", "start", "end", "gene"))
# Match genes to the windows
peri_centromeres_chromatin <- as.data.table(peri_centromeres_chromatin)
peri_centromeres_chromatin[, chr := paste0("Chr", chrom)]
pc_genes <- peri_centromeres_chromatin[peri_centromeres_chromatin$merged_state=="CH",]
```

## Get genes 1-1 orthology in A.lyrata and C. rubella
```{r}
## ## ## ## ## ## ## ## 
## Capsella processing ## 
## ## ## ## ## ## ## ## 
capsella_gff <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/c_rubella/Crubella_474_v1.1.gene.gff3", skip = 2, sep = "\t", header = FALSE)
## Set names 
setnames(capsella_gff, c("chr", "source", "type", "start", "end", "score", "strand", "phase", "attributes"))
# Filter only gene rows
capsella_genes <- capsella_gff[type == "gene", .(chr, start, end, attributes)]
# Get the name 
capsella_genes[, gene_id := sub(".*ID=([^;]+).*", "\\1", attributes)]
capsella_genes[, gene_clean := sub("\\.v[0-9.]+$", "", gene_id)] 

## ## ## ## ## ## ## ## 
## Lyrata processing ## 
## ## ## ## ## ## ## ## 

lyrata_gff <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/mn47/8_longest_scaffolds.gtf", skip = 2, sep = "\t", header = FALSE)
## Set names 
setnames(lyrata_gff, c("chr", "source", "type", "start", "end", "score", "strand", "phase", "attributes"))
# Filter only gene rows
lyrata_genes <- lyrata_gff[type == "gene", .(chr, start, end, attributes)]
# Get the name 
lyrata_genes[, gene_id := sub(".*ID=([^;]+).*", "\\1", attributes)]
lyrata_genes[, gene_clean := sub("\\.v[0-9.]+$", "", gene_id)] 
lyrata_genes[, gene_clean := sub('.*locus_tag "([^"]+)".*', '\\1', gene_clean)]
lyrata_genes <- lyrata_genes %>% select(chr,start,end,gene_clean)
```
## Process single copy orthologous genes 
```{r}
# Load the full Orthogroups file
og_full <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/03_processing/orthofinder_tair10_mn47_arenosa_capsella/OrthoFinder/Results_May12/Orthogroups/Orthogroups.tsv")

# Load the list of Single Copy Orthogroup IDs
sc_ids <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/03_processing/orthofinder_tair10_mn47_arenosa_capsella/OrthoFinder/Results_May12/Orthogroups/Orthogroups_SingleCopyOrthologues.txt", header = FALSE)$V1

# Filter the full table to keep only 1-1 orthologous sequences
og_sc <- og_full[Orthogroup %in% sc_ids]
og_sc <- og_sc %>% select(Orthogroup,Athaliana_167_protein_primaryTranscriptOnly, Crubella_474_v1.1.protein_primaryTranscriptOnly,GCA_944990045.1_MN47_v2_primaryTranscriptOnly)
```
## Join thaliana, capsella, lyrata 
```{r}
## Join dataframes and mark if the gene is single-copy orthologous 
## Attach thaliana coordinates
og_sc$athal_gene <- gsub("\\..*", "", og_sc$Athaliana_167_protein_primaryTranscriptOnly)
og_sc$alyr_gene <- og_sc$GCA_944990045.1_MN47_v2_primaryTranscriptOnly
og_sc$capsella_gene <- og_sc$Crubella_474_v1.1.protein_primaryTranscriptOnly
og_sc$capsella_gene <- gsub("(\\.\\w+)\\..*", "\\1", og_sc$capsella_gene)
# Select necessary columns
og_sc <- og_sc %>% select(Orthogroup,athal_gene,alyr_gene,capsella_gene)

## Add coordinates thaliana
og_sc_athal <- left_join(
  og_sc,
  annotation_athaliana %>% rename_with(~ paste0(., "_athal"), -gene),
  by = c("athal_gene" = "gene")
)

## Add coordinates lyrata
og_sc_athal_lyr <- left_join(
  og_sc_athal,
  lyrata_genes %>% rename_with(~ paste0(., "_alyr"), -gene_clean),
  by = c("alyr_gene" = "gene_clean")
)

## Add coordinates capsella
capsella_genes <- capsella_genes %>% select(chr,start,end,gene_clean)

og_sc_athal_lyr_capsella <- left_join(
  og_sc_athal_lyr,
  capsella_genes %>% rename_with(~ paste0(., "_capsella"), -gene_clean),
  by = c("capsella_gene" = "gene_clean")
)
```
## Visualization of the alignment 
```{r}
# Filter genes to be out of peri-centromere
library(data.table)

# Your annotation (A. thaliana genes)
# annotation_athaliana should have: chr, start, end, gene

# Overlap genes with pericentromere windows
pc_gene_ids <- annotation_athaliana[
  pc_genes[, .(chr, window_start, window_end)],
  on = .(chr, start >= window_start, end <= window_end),
  nomatch = 0
]$gene

# Now filter og_sc table
non_pc <- og_sc_athal_lyr_capsella[!athal_gene %in% pc_gene_ids]
pc     <- og_sc_athal_lyr_capsella[ athal_gene %in% pc_gene_ids]
```


```{r}
# Rank by A. thaliana position
non_pc <- non_pc[order(chr_athal, start_athal)]
non_pc[, rank_Ath := 1:.N]

# Rank by Capsella position
non_pc <- non_pc[order(chr_capsella, start_capsella)]
non_pc[, rank_Cap := 1:.N]

# Rank by Lyrata position
non_pc <- non_pc[order(chr_alyr, start_alyr)]
non_pc[, rank_Lyr := 1:.N]
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

non_pc$chr_athal <- factor(non_pc$chr_athal, levels = c("Chr1","Chr2","Chr3","Chr4","Chr5"))

# Ath vs Capsella
non_pc <- na.omit(non_pc)
ggplot(non_pc, aes(x = rank_Ath, y = rank_Cap, color = chr_athal)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Chr (Ath)") +
  labs(x = "Rank in A. thaliana", y = "Rank in Capsella",
       title = "Non-pericentromeric: Ath vs Capsella") +
  theme_minimal()

# Ath vs Lyrata
ggplot(non_pc, aes(x = rank_Ath, y = rank_Lyr, color = chr_athal)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Chr (Ath)") +
  labs(x = "Rank in A. thaliana", y = "Rank in A. lyrata",
       title = "Non-pericentromeric: Ath vs Alyr") +
  theme_minimal()

```
## Define off diagonal points. Genes where the linear oderd in A thaliana but differ from capsella
```{r}
library(data.table)

# Sort by Ath rank
setorder(non_pc, rank_Ath)

# Calculate rank difference from diagonal
non_pc[, rank_diff := rank_Ath - rank_Cap]

# A gene is part of a block if its rank_diff is similar to its neighbors
non_pc[, diff_prev := abs(rank_diff - shift(rank_diff, 1))]
non_pc[, diff_next := abs(rank_diff - shift(rank_diff, -1))]

# "Single dot" = both neighbors have very different rank_diff
# i.e., it is NOT part of a consecutive run
block_threshold <- 100  # adjust based on your data density

non_pc[, is_single := (is.na(diff_prev) | diff_prev > block_threshold) & 
                      (is.na(diff_next) | diff_next > block_threshold)]

cat("Number of single off-diagonal genes:", sum(non_pc$is_single))
```
## Check exon-intron structure
```{r}
ggplot(non_pc, aes(x = rank_Ath, y = rank_Cap, color = chr_athal)) +
  geom_point(data = non_pc[is_single == FALSE], size = 1.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = non_pc[is_single == TRUE], size = 2.5, alpha = 1, shape = 17) +  # triangles for singles
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Chr (Ath)") +
  labs(x = "Rank in A. thaliana", y = "Rank in Capsella",
       title = "Non-pericentromeric: Ath vs Capsella\n(triangles = moved genes)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
## Check exon-intron structure in Arabidopsis 
```{r}
single_moved_genes <- non_pc[non_pc$is_single=="TRUE",]

athaliana_gff <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff")
ath_genes_gff <- athaliana_gff[V3 == "gene" |V3 == "transposable_element_gene"]
ath_genes_gff[, gene_id := sub(".*ID=([^;]+).*", "\\1", V9)]
## Map to the genes 
single_moved_genes_mapped <- inner_join(single_moved_genes,ath_genes_gff, by=c("athal_gene"="gene_id"))
## Check presene of introns
```

```{r}
# Extract exons for moved genes only
ath_exons <- athaliana_gff[V3 == "exon"]
ath_exons[, gene_id := sub(".*Parent=([^.]+).*", "\\1", V9)]

# Count exons per gene → introns = exons - 1
gene_structure <- ath_exons[gene_id %in% single_moved_genes$athal_gene,
                             .(n_exons = .N), by = gene_id]
gene_structure[, n_introns := n_exons - 1]
gene_structure[, has_intron := n_introns > 0]

head(gene_structure)
gene_structure[gene_structure$n_introns>1,]
```

## Capsella thaliana make a dotplot
```{r}
# Sort by A. thaliana position
pc_with_capsella <- as.data.table(pc_with_capsella)
pc_with_capsella <- pc_with_capsella[order(chr_Ath, start_Ath)]
pc_with_capsella[, rank_Ath := 1:.N]
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# factor and optional palette
pc_with_capsella$chr_Ath <- factor(pc_with_capsella$chr_Ath,
                                   levels = unique(pc_with_capsella$chr_Ath))

# Set ordered chromosome levels
pc_with_capsella$chr_Ath <- factor(pc_with_capsella$chr_Ath, levels = c("Chr1", "Chr2", "Chr3", "Chr4", "Chr5"))

# Plot with facets
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(pc_with_capsella, aes(x = rank_Ath, y = rank_Cap, color = chr_Ath)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "A. thaliana\nchromosome") +
  labs(x = "Rank in A. thaliana (pericentromeric)",
       y = "Rank in Capsella",
       title = "A. thaliana VS C. rubella") +
  facet_wrap(~ chr_Ath, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal()
```
## Add A. lyrata
```{r}
# Load Capsella GFF
lyrata_gff <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/mn47/Phytozome/PhytozomeV12/Alyrata/annotation/Alyrata_384_v2.1.gene.gff3", skip = 2, sep = "\t", header = FALSE)
setnames(lyrata_gff, c("seqid","source","type","start","end","score","strand","phase","attributes"))

# keep only gene lines and extract ID
al_genes <- lyrata_gff[type == "gene", .(seqid, start, end, attributes)]
al_genes[, gene_id := sub(".*ID=([^;]+).*", "\\1", attributes)]
al_genes[, gene_id := as.character(gene_id)]
# optional: drop the attributes column
al_genes <- al_genes[, .(seqid, start, end, gene_id)]
```
